verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an AI code editor, but nothing in the pack documents a way to disable telemetry or usage tracking. Privacy Mode only keeps code from being used for training, which is a related but different control. OpenTelemetry Export and the Analytics API collect and expose usage data rather than letting users opt out of it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
